boundary_evidence: contiguous linker run: 0x02015a7c..0x02015d38, 13 function(s), gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt, every entry complete.

The run is the whole of one class: dExtFrameCtrl_c's eight ordinary methods (Copy, WillHitFrame, Finished, GetFlags, SetFlags, GetFrameCount, SetAnimation, Advance), then its destructor variants D2/D0/D1 and constructor variants C1/C2. notes/model-rtti-names.md recovers the family.

HISTORY (closed by the STRUCTOR FOLD below): the ABI tail used to stay sharded because a TU that defines ~dExtFrameCtrl_c() emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS, and under the coined '9Animation' spelling those names had no cartridge home. The class rename to the ROM's dExtFrameCtrl_c closed that.

STRUCTOR FOLD: D2 0x02015cb4, D0 0x02015cc4, D1 0x02015ce8, C1 0x02015cf8 and C2 0x02015d18 moved in from their per-function shards. One ~dExtFrameCtrl_c() and one dExtFrameCtrl_c() at the top of the file emit all five variants last, in ROM order. The key function now emits _ZTV15dExtFrameCtrl_c/_ZTI15dExtFrameCtrl_c/_ZTS15dExtFrameCtrl_c. Each has a cartridge home in arm9 .data among the model family's records (0x0208e7e4/0x0208e744/0x0208e84c), outside this text-only TU, so they are deadstrip-data rows checked by romdata_check.
LoadFile (0x0201794c) and UpdateFileOffsets (0x020469ac) are dExtFrameCtrl_c members too, but they link in other neighbourhoods and keep their own shards; they are not part of this run.

The neighbour before the run, _ZN15TextureSequenceC1Ev ending at 0x02015a7c, is a TextureSequence constructor; _ZN11ShadowModel9RenderAllEv begins at 0x02015d38. Neither is a dExtFrameCtrl_c method licensed here.

notes: Text-only. The class's _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS stay in the cartridge .data at 0x0208e744..0x0208e858; this TU's copies are deadstrip-data, compared against the cartridge by romdata_check and then discarded.
mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order, so the file is ROM-descending.

SetAnimation keeps a mangled extern-C definition at file scope: its declared signature passes Fix12<int> by value, and the wall 6az homes class-typed by-value parameters, so the member definition cannot be spelled without changing bytes (see the local extern note in the source).

compiler_only_output.reason: This class's own record. The TU defines dExtFrameCtrl_c's key function, the destructor (its first declared non-inline virtual), so mwcc emits the record as vague linkage. The cartridge keeps its canonical copy at arm9:0x0208e7e4, interleaved with the other model-family records and outside this TU's only licensed range (.text 0x02015a7c-0x02015d38). dsd delinks it from the cartridge independently, so discarding this object's copy cannot cost the image a byte. romdata_check compares the emitted copy against the cartridge, relocations applied, before production isolation discards it.
